description: HTTP, Node.js, and application DB/Redis metrics for Zilla backends, including shared-model tenant splits.

panels.description: HTTP rate by validated tenant label. Shared backends keep one target and still split here.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant) (rate(zilla_http_requests_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))

panels.title: Requests per second by tenant

panels.description: HTTP rate by backend pod. Rate is taken per series, then summed by pod across methods and routes.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(zilla_http_requests_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))

panels.title: Requests per second by pod

panels.description: Gauge of requests currently handled by each backend pod. Shown per pod; do not average this value across pods.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, method) (zilla_http_requests_in_flight{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: In-flight requests by pod

panels.description: Sum of in-flight gauges across selected backend pods. Summing is valid because each pod reports its own concurrent requests.

targets.expr: sum(zilla_http_requests_in_flight{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: In-flight requests total

panels.description: 5xx ratio by tenant. Built from counters, not from averaged gauges.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant) (rate(zilla_http_requests_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod", status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (tenant) (rate(zilla_http_requests_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Error rate by tenant

panels.description: Overall HTTP latency. histogram_quantile after summing buckets across pods by le.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(zilla_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(zilla_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(zilla_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Per-tenant p95 from histogram buckets. Buckets are summed by le and tenant before quantile.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (rate(zilla_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

panels.title: p95 latency by tenant

panels.description: Slowest normalized Express routes. Route labels are templates such as /api/project/:projectKey, never raw URLs.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(zilla_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

panels.title: p95 latency by route

panels.description: Highest 4xx/5xx rates by normalized route and status. Instant table so current hotspots are readable during a load run.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route, status_code, tenant) (rate(zilla_http_requests_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod", status_code=~"[45].."}[5m])))

panels.title: Top error routes

panels.description: Highest p95 routes after aggregating histogram buckets across pods.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(zilla_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95)

panels.description: Node.js heap gauges per backend pod. Series are not summed across pods because each process has its own heap.

targets.expr: zilla_nodejs_heap_size_used_bytes{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}
zilla_nodejs_heap_size_total_bytes{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}

panels.title: Heap used and total by pod

panels.description: process RSS per backend pod. Shown per pod; summing would hide which replica is growing.

targets.expr: zilla_process_resident_memory_bytes{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}

panels.title: Resident memory by pod

panels.description: User plus system CPU seconds from prom-client. Rate is per pod, not an average of gauges.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(zilla_process_cpu_user_seconds_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]) + rate(zilla_process_cpu_system_seconds_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))

panels.title: Process CPU by pod

panels.description: prom-client event-loop lag. Mean and p99 are gauges of a delay, so the panel uses the per-pod value rather than summing lag across pods.

targets.expr: max by (pod) (zilla_nodejs_eventloop_lag_mean_seconds{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"})

max by (pod) (zilla_nodejs_eventloop_lag_p99_seconds{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Event-loop lag by pod

panels.description: Sequelize operations recorded by the backend. Split by operation, status, and tenant.

targets.expr: sum by (operation, status, tenant) (rate(zilla_db_operations_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))

panels.title: DB operations per second

panels.description: p95 DB duration from histogram buckets, aggregated across pods by le, operation, and tenant.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation, tenant) (rate(zilla_db_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

panels.title: DB operation p95

panels.description: Gauge of pool state per tenant. Each state is plotted separately so size/using/waiting are not summed into a meaningless total.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant, state) (zilla_db_pool_connections{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Sequelize pool connections

panels.description: Application Redis calls recorded by the backend, including errors.

targets.expr: sum by (operation, status, tenant) (rate(zilla_redis_operations_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))

panels.title: Redis operations per second

panels.description: p95 Redis duration from histogram buckets after summing across pods by le.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation, tenant) (rate(zilla_redis_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

panels.title: Redis operation p95

panels.description: Error-status counters for application DB and Redis calls.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant) (rate(zilla_db_operations_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod", status="error"}[5m]))

sum by (tenant) (rate(zilla_redis_operations_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod", status="error"}[5m]))
